_note: PLACEHOLDER SET. Three questions, one per shape, chosen to exercise the harness rather
than to measure anything. Real questions get backfilled.
When they are written, §18.3 applies: draw them from real behaviour, real past
confusion, and real questions someone actually asked — never from a bundle's table of
contents, which flatters the bundle by construction. Then verify each one is answerable
from source in BOTH arms, which is what `answerable_from` records and what

questions.text: What runtime does the deterministic build require, and what has to be installed before it will run?
claims: standard library only — no third-party packages
no install step; the folder is copied and run

questions.text: The build stops at the first failing step instead of running the remaining ones. Why was it built that way?
claims: a later step would read what the failed step did not write
that produces a second, misleading failure
the misleading one is the failure people chase

questions.text: I need a relation predicate that does not exist yet. What do I change, and what am I not allowed to do?
claims: add the term to the predicate vocabulary
a pack may overlay additional predicates rather than editing core
an unknown predicate is rejected outright, unlike an unknown type
an existing predicate may never be redefined
